function.name: debugstr_hook_id
function.description: This function returns the name of the hook corresponding to the given id. If the id is out of range, it returns the id as a string.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: This parameter represents the id of the hook.

function.return_type: char: Returns the name of the hook corresponding to the id as a string. If the id is out of range, it returns the id as a string.

function.name: is_hooked
function.description: This function checks if a given id is hooked in a shared queue.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: This parameter represents the id to be checked if it's hooked in the shared queue.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the given id is hooked or not.

function.name: NtUserSetWindowsHookEx
function.description: This function installs an application-defined hook procedure into a hook chain. The hook procedure can monitor the system for certain types of events. These events are associated either with a specific thread or with all threads in the same desktop as the calling thread.

parameters.name: inst
parameters.description: A handle to the DLL containing the hook procedure pointed to by the lpfn parameter

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: A pointer to a UNICODE_STRING structure that contains the name of the DLL containing the hook procedure pointed to by the lpfn parameter

parameters.name: tid
parameters.description: The identifier of the thread with which the hook procedure is to be associated

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The type of hook procedure to be installed

parameters.name: proc
parameters.description: A pointer to the hook procedure

parameters.name: ansi
parameters.description: A boolean value that specifies whether the hook procedure processes ANSI or Unicode messages

function.return_type: HHOOK. If the function succeeds, the return value is the handle to the hook procedure. If the function fails, the return value is NULL

function.name: NtUserUnhookWindowsHookEx
function.description: This function is used to remove a system-wide hook installed by a previous call to the function.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is a handle to the hook to be removed.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns a boolean value indicating the success or failure of the function. If the function succeeds, the return value is nonzero. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: NtUserUnhookWindowsHook
function.description: This function is used to unhook a Windows hook.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: This is the identifier of the hook to be removed.

parameters.name: proc
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the hook procedure.

function.return_type: BOOL. Returns a non-zero value if the function succeeds, and zero if it fails.

function.name: NtUserCallMsgFilter
function.description: This function calls hooks based on the given code and message. If the system message filter hook is called successfully, it returns TRUE. Otherwise, it calls the message filter hook.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the message to be processed.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: This is the code based on which the appropriate hook is called.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the hook was called successfully or not.

function.name: get_ll_hook_timeout
function.description: This function is intended to retrieve the LowLevelHooksTimeout in HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Desktop, but currently it returns a fixed value of 2000.
function.return_type: UINT, represents the LowLevelHooksTimeout value, currently returns 2000

function.name: call_hook
function.description: This function is used to call a hook in a thread or process. It handles different types of hooks and manages memory allocation and deallocation for the hook parameters. It also handles recursive hook calls and prevents stack overflow.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to the structure containing the hook parameters.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Pointer to the module name where the hook is located.

parameters.name: lparam_size
parameters.description: Size of the lparam parameter.

parameters.name: message_size
parameters.description: Size of the message parameter.

parameters.name: ansi
parameters.description: Boolean value indicating whether the message is in ANSI format or not.

function.return_type: LRESULT, represents the result of the hook call. If the hook call fails, it returns 0.

function.name: NtUserCallNextHookEx
function.description: This function is used to call the next hook in the hook chain. It is typically used in hook procedures to allow the system to continue processing the hook.

parameters.name: hhook
parameters.description: A handle to the current hook. This parameter is ignored.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The hook code passed to the current hook procedure. This code determines how to process the hook.

parameters.name: wparam
parameters.description: The first message parameter. Its interpretation depends on the code.

parameters.name: lparam
parameters.description: The second message parameter. Its interpretation depends on the code.

function.return_type: LRESULT. The return value specifies the result of the message processing and depends on the message sent.

function.name: call_current_hook
function.description: This function calls the current hook, retrieves hook information from the server, sets up parameters for the hook, and then calls the hook.

parameters.name: hhook
parameters.description: A handle to the hook to be called.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The hook code passed to the hook procedure.

parameters.name: wparam
parameters.description: The first parameter passed to the hook procedure.

parameters.name: lparam
parameters.description: The second parameter passed to the hook procedure.

function.return_type: LRESULT, represents the result of the hook call.

function.name: call_message_hooks
function.description: This function calls message hooks, checks if the hook is active, starts and finishes a hook chain on a server, and returns the result of a hook call.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier for the hook

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Code for the hook

parameters.name: wparam
parameters.description: First message parameter

parameters.name: lparam
parameters.description: Second message parameter

parameters.name: lparam_size
parameters.description: Size of the second message parameter

parameters.name: message_size
parameters.description: Size of the message

parameters.name: ansi
parameters.description: Boolean value indicating if the message is ANSI or not

function.return_type: LRESULT, represents the result of the hook call

function.name: call_hooks
function.description: This function calls the 'call_message_hooks' function with the given parameters and returns the result.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An identifier for the hook to be called

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: A code to be passed to the hook

parameters.name: wparam
parameters.description: A parameter to be passed to the hook

parameters.name: lparam
parameters.description: Another parameter to be passed to the hook

parameters.name: lparam_size
parameters.description: The size of the 'lparam' parameter

function.return_type: LRESULT, the result of the 'call_message_hooks' function

function.name: NtUserSetWinEventHook
function.description: This function sets a hook function for a range of events. It checks for valid parameters, sets the hook request and returns a handle to the event hook.

parameters.name: event_min
parameters.description: The event constant for the lowest event value in the range of events that the hook procedure monitors.

parameters.name: event_max
parameters.description: The event constant for the highest event value in the range of events that the hook procedure monitors.

parameters.name: inst
parameters.description: A handle to the DLL that contains the hook procedure.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Pointer to a string that specifies the name of the module to be loaded.

parameters.name: proc
parameters.description: A pointer to the hook procedure.

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: The identifier of the process to be hooked.

parameters.name: tid
parameters.description: The identifier of the thread to be hooked.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Specifies the location of the hook function and of the events to be skipped.

function.return_type: HWINEVENTHOOK. It represents a handle to the event hook. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: NtUserUnhookWinEvent
function.description: This function unhooks a win event from the system.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is a handle to the event hook to be removed.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the unhooking was successful or not.

function.name: NtUserNotifyWinEvent
function.description: This function is used to notify the system about an event that an assistive technology product might be interested in. It checks if the window handle is valid and if the event is hooked. If both conditions are met, it starts a hook chain, calls the event hook, gets the hook info, and finishes the hook chain.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Specifies the event that occurred.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window that generates the event.

parameters.name: object_id
parameters.description: Identifies the object associated with the event.

parameters.name: child_id
parameters.description: Identifies whether the event was triggered by an object or a child element of the object.

function.return_type: void, it does not return a value but performs actions based on the parameters received.
